verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents scoped API keys that restrict access to a single pod or a single inbox, and separate Permissions that restrict what an API key can do. Together these give resource-level and action-level least-privilege credentials for agents, and the multi-tenancy guide explicitly recommends issuing a scoped key per pod. Missing for 10: detail on the specific permission set (which actions can be granted or denied), documentation of key issuance and revocation flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
